test_coverage::pytest.ini.head:
# pytest configuration for the taskq-cc-new project.
#
# The `testpaths` setting limits pytest's collection to the project's
# own tests under `03-development/tests/`. Without this, mutmut
# collects every test file on sys.path — including the harness's
# own tests (`harness/tests/`) which import from the harness's
# `core/` package and fail when the workdir cwd is not the harness
# root. The framework-level `test_suite_run` and `spec_coverage`
# modules already scope to `03-development/tests` directly via the
# `resolve_targets` helper, so this file does not change the gate
# or the per-FR evidence pipeline — only the implicit collection
# surface that mutmut and a bare `pytest` invocation would use.
#
# The `pythonpath = 03-development/src` line mirrors the project-
# level convention; the `conftest.py` under `03-development/tests/`
# also adds the same directory to `sys.path` so this is belt-and-
# braces.
[pytest]
testpaths = 03-development/tests
pythonpath = 03-development/src
